_note: SAMPLE — automatic encryption-key recovery. Merge the "security" block below into your config.json. When encryption-at-rest is on and the master key is missing on startup, the app restores it from recoveryPath using the passphrase and boots normally, with NO pre-login prompt. If you do NOT configure this, a missing key instead shows the pre-login recovery screen where an operator uploads the key + passphrase by hand.

security._keyProtector_options: file | passphrase | dpapi (Windows, host-bound) | systemd-creds (Linux, host-bound) | auto
security._recoveryPath_note: Path to your exported recovery key (the .atrestkey file downloaded from Settings -> Backup & Recovery). Defaults to recovery.atrestkey beside keyPath if omitted.
security._passphrase_options: Provide the passphrase via exactly one of: passphraseFile (path to a file containing it), passphraseEnv (name of an env var, e.g. ATREST_PASSPHRASE), or passphrase (inline string, discouraged in production).
security._security_note: Storing the recovery key and its passphrase together on the same host defeats the point in a real breach. Prefer a mounted secret / env var injected at deploy time (e.g. Docker secrets).
